baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative chain from ءَامَنُوا through ٱتَّقُوا, ٱبْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ, جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ, and تُفْلِحُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust initiates self-protection; protected desire deliberately seeks a means toward God; effort then spends capacity along His traversable way; flourishing names the hoped-for arrival. The repeated directional markers إِلَيْهِ and فِي سَبِيلِهِ keep every action oriented rather than self-grounded.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security supplies the stable point from which the commanded movement begins.
Putting oneself within protection makes taqwa the governing posture of the whole route.
Worship and the worshipped one identify the endpoint and owner of the way.
Deliberate seeking turns the means from a static possession into an pursued relation.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies the route's costly motion.
A traversable extended road gives the exertion a defined course and means of arrival.
Winning, survival, and attained good provide the prospective result without making it automatic.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of separate pious commands followed by a promise of success.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is one directed approach sequence: inward security becomes guarded desire, guarded desire seeks access, access is enacted through costly travel in God's way, and flourishing remains the hoped-for arrival.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The proximity of ٱتَّقُوا, ٱبْتَغُوا, and جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root that supplies seeking can also image transgression, while exertion can mean driving another to the limit. Taqwa and the possessive 'His way' therefore function as internal governors: intensity is legitimate only while protected from crossing limits or consuming another's capacity.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the ethical check placed before seeking and exertion.
The branch's limit-crossing aggression exposes the danger latent in undirected seeking.
Bringing a person or thing to the edge of hardship marks the possible excess within exertion.
The specified road confines energy to a course rather than treating sheer force as self-validating.

changed_reading.before: Greater intensity in seeking and striving is necessarily better.
changed_reading.after: The ayah commands disciplined exertion: protection and God's defined way bound desire so that striving does not mutate into transgression or imposed exhaustion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Exertion can image exposed hard ground, a way can image a forward outlet, and falah can image splitting open a constriction before it names winning. Together they make the means an enabling passage through resistance: effort does not merely occur on a prefinished road but helps make an obstructed route passable.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed land materializes the resistance through which the command moves.
A forward lip or outlet makes the path an aperture through resistance.
Splitting and opening from a narrow place supplies the mechanical shape of breakthrough.
The winning branch converts the made opening into durable arrival rather than a momentary breach.

changed_reading.before: Falah is a generic reward reached after generic effort.
changed_reading.after: Falah is breakthrough: strenuous passage works resistant ground until a God-oriented outlet opens and can be inhabited as enduring good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier offering scene joins nearness and offering to repeated acceptance, then states that acceptance is from the protected. This revises wasila from an object that secures access into an approach whose reception depends on the seeker's guarded condition.

activation_trace.role: Active seeking anchors the revised model in the focus command to pursue the means.
Self-placement in protection anchors the condition that precedes the means.
Near-drawing and offering to God supply a concrete approach that can be tested rather than presumed effective.
Repeated acceptance with satisfaction makes reception, not mere presentation, decisive.
The protected persons are named as those from whom acceptance occurs, linking approach to guarded character.

structural_cues: 5:27 repeats acceptance three times and closes by restricting it to the muttaqin before 5:35 again places taqwa before seeking the means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offering, acceptance, and taqwa; I infer that their sequence regulates the focus's means of approach. A live alternative is that 5:27 only narrates one failed ritual approach and does not define wasila generally.

changed_reading.before: Wasila may be a technique or presented thing that itself guarantees nearness.
changed_reading.after: Wasila is an integrity-bearing approach: the seeker cannot purchase reception by presenting a means while bypassing the protected condition from which God accepts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first mirrors extending and withholding a hand to kill, then scales killing or preserving one life to all people, and finally names hostile, purposeful motion in the earth as corruption. These contrasts make direction and effect, not kinetic intensity, the diagnostic of striving in God's way.

activation_trace.role: Costly expenditure is the focus action whose moral direction the context tests.
The specified traversable road anchors the claim that effort is judged by its course.
The extended hand and refused counter-extension stage bodily capacity under restraint.
Taking life identifies the concrete outcome from which the hand is withheld.
Preserving life and leaving killing undone supplies the positive social measure of directed action.
Departure from sound order names the destructive alternative to life-preserving action.
War and enmity provide an explicit hostile mode that cannot be equated with every difficult exertion.
Purposeful motion toward an object shows that energetic movement can serve corruption when its object is corrupt.
Corruption supplies the named result that differentiates anti-path motion from striving in God's path.

structural_cues: 5:28 mirrors hand extension and non-extension; 5:32 balances killing and giving life; 5:33 couples purposeful movement with corruption immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, life-preservation, and a negative model of energetic corrupting motion; I infer that they bound the focus's jihad by direction and consequence. The punitive legal response in 5:33 remains a live alternative pressure, so this is a directional boundary rather than a claim of absolute nonviolence.

changed_reading.before: Jihad can be identified by the amount of force or hardship expended.
changed_reading.after: Jihad in His way is effort morally diagnosed by its God-given route and life-ordering effect; forceful motion toward corruption is its contextual counterimage, not a more intense instance of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding exception opens a return before others gain power, then seals it with protective forgiveness and mercy. Seeking a means can therefore include a timely route of return for one already implicated in destructive motion, not only forward advancement by an already secure subject.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful seeking anchors repentance as a possible active form of pursuing access.
The available summons-to-repent branch makes the exception an opened call to reverse course.
Precedence and coming-before supply the exception's decisive temporal threshold.
Power that enables action marks the external capture point before which voluntary return remains open.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the route's restorative shelter.
Merciful tenderness prevents the return route from being reduced to tactical escape.

structural_cues: The repentance-before-power exception is the final sentence before the focus address and is followed by forgiveness and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal exception and restorative divine attributes; I infer that this is one contextual shape of the means sought in 5:35. A live alternative confines 5:34 to the legal status of the preceding offenders.

changed_reading.before: The means is for believers who are already moving cleanly forward.
changed_reading.after: The means also names an available return trajectory: before coercion closes voluntary agency, reversal, covering, and mercy can reorient even a damaged path toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, total earthly wealth doubled cannot serve as an accepted substitute, and the desired exit is no longer traversable. This makes the means neither stored capital nor a late ransom: it is a path enacted while seeking, protection, and exertion remain possible.

activation_trace.role: Active pursuit anchors the means in present conduct rather than retained exchange value.
A road that must be traversed supplies the focus alternative to substitution.
Putting one thing in place of another supplies the rejected transactional model of access.
Refused acceptance shows that even maximal substitute value cannot compel reception.
Passage to the outside is desired and denied, turning the focus road into a time-sensitive opening.

structural_cues: 5:36-37 directly follow لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ with an unaccepted ransom and a twice-stated failed exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitution and failed exit; I infer that they contrast with the focus's present-tense enacted route. A live alternative is that these verses only describe eschatological impossibility without classifying wasila.

changed_reading.before: Wasila might be a valuable resource saved for securing a favorable outcome.
changed_reading.after: Wasila is nontransferable passage-work performed now; no accumulated equivalent can later replace guarded seeking and travel in the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address exposes a claim of belief that remains at the mouth and has not entered the heart. The focus address to 'those who believed' is therefore a starting claim tested by the ensuing sequence: only heart-settling trust can generate protective, directed, costly movement.

activation_trace.role: Heart-calming assent anchors the focus address as an inwardly realized state.
The repeated belief root is explicitly asserted and negated across two bodily locations, testing the focus label.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the external claim that cannot carry the route by itself.
The heart supplies the denied site of belief and the later site needing purification.

structural_cues: 5:41 states 'we believed with their mouths' and immediately negates belief in their hearts using the same root as the focus address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mouth-heart contrast; I infer that the commands after the focus address function as enactment tests of belief. The alternative is that 5:41 concerns a distinct hypocritical group without revising 5:35's addressee.

changed_reading.before: The opening address certifies a completed identity, after which additional duties are listed.
changed_reading.after: The opening address names a claim that must become cardiac and kinetic: taqwa, seeking, and effort reveal whether spoken belief has actually settled into the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance arrives by following preserved traces, yet the packet also assigns a water-access/course and a clear road to each community, calls this differentiation a test, redirects competition toward goods, and gathers all return to God. 'His way' thus names a common vector and evaluative destination without requiring every historically assigned route to have identical form.

activation_trace.role: The focus's extended traversable road anchors the question of unity and differentiation.
Following an earlier trace gives guidance a sequential, inherited mode of travel.
A remaining sign makes prior passage legible to a later traveler.
Gentle indication toward road and truth names the orienting function carried through the traces.
A manifest water-access point supplies a distinct allotted entry to sustaining guidance.
A clear disclosed road supplies the explicit course paired with each allotted access.
Testing that reveals condition makes differentiated routes an arena of disclosure rather than proof of self-sufficiency.
Advancing in a race transfers competition from possession of the route to enacted movement.
Inclination toward useful good fixes the race's object and moral measure.
Return to the prior source supplies the single endpoint that gathers differentiated travel.

structural_cues: 5:46 follows traces carrying guidance; 5:48 places distinct shir'a and minhaj beside testing, racing in goods, and a collective return to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traced succession, differentiated courses, a shared ethical race, and one return; I infer that these distinguish common vector from identical route-form. A live alternative restricts the differentiation to legal dispensations and leaves the focus's singular path institutionally uniform.

changed_reading.before: His singular way implies one undifferentiated historical route, and success means possessing its label.
changed_reading.after: His way is a Godward vector recognizable through preserved traces, tested route-specific obedience, and a race in useful good; unity lies in orientation and return, not mere sameness of route-form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same seeking root later takes 'judgment of jahiliyya' as its object and is opposed to settled certainty about God's judgment. Seeking is therefore morally plastic: the object and direction train desire either into a means toward God or into a return to ungrounded judgment.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful pursuit anchors the focus's command to direct desire toward God.
The repeated pursuit branch carries the same seeking energy toward a contrary object.
Limit-crossing desire exposes how pursuit becomes aggression when its object departs from truth.
The jahiliyya order supplies the regressive object that deforms seeking.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the settled counter-posture to misdirected desire.

structural_cues: 5:35 and 5:50 repeat the ب غ ي root with sharply opposed objects: a means toward God and judgment of jahiliyya.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and opposed objects; I infer that object and direction morally form the act of seeking. A live alternative treats the repetition as ordinary vocabulary rather than a deliberate callback.

changed_reading.before: Seeking is intrinsically devout because it is energetic and sincere.
changed_reading.after: Seeking must itself be converted: desire becomes wasila only when its object and direction are Godward; the same energy can pursue a regressive order and cross the limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disordered hearts rush because they fear a hostile turn of the cycle, while the counter-event is an opening from God. The opening branches resonate with falah's splitting branch: flourishing becomes release from fear-driven circular calculation into a widened God-given passage.

activation_trace.role: Splitting open from constriction anchors the focus outcome as breakthrough rather than generic advantage.
Weakening and impaired motion diagnose why the heart cannot hold a straight course.
Circulation of conditions supplies the feared political loop that drives opportunistic haste.
An obstruction opening into a widened entrance supplies the straight counterimage to fearful circulation.
Opening into victory ties the spatial release to the reversal the fearful calculators try to control.

structural_cues: 5:52 moves from heart-sickness and fear of a da'ira to the possibility of a divine fath, then to exposure and regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation and opening; I supply the cross-root arrow from fath's opening to falah's splitting. A live alternative reads fath strictly as a future judgment or victory event with no semantic effect on falah.

changed_reading.before: Falah means gaining the favorable side of changing fortunes.
changed_reading.after: Falah is release from the cycle of fear-based positioning: the protected seeker holds a straight Godward course until an obstruction opens, rather than orbiting every anticipated reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's exertion root reappears as the utmost intensity of oaths, yet those speakers' works collapse. Juhd therefore cannot be validated by maximal verbal force, solemnity, or self-presentation; it must become aligned action that survives the test of the path.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure of capacity under hardship anchors the focus's enacted demand.
A formally distributed oath supplies the solemn speech-act whose intensity proves insufficient.
The exact exertion branch intensifies the oaths and exposes intensity without faithful trajectory.
The oath branch locates the exertion in declaration rather than durable deed.
Collapse and falling away give the verbal maximum a failed outcome.
Purposeful work supplies the embodiment that is judged void despite emphatic oaths.

structural_cues: 5:53 places جَهْدَ inside emphatic oaths and immediately follows it with the collapse of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition and the oath/work reversal; I infer that it audits what counts as valid exertion in 5:35. A live alternative treats جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ as an idiom with no callback to جَاهِدُوا.

changed_reading.before: Jihad is authenticated by how absolute, strenuous, or loudly pledged it appears.
changed_reading.after: Jihad is embodied fidelity along the path: maximal oath-intensity can coexist with collapsed work, so exertion is authenticated by durable direction rather than verbal force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus phrase 'they strive in the way of God' returns inside a social and affective profile: mutual love with God, gentleness without humiliation toward believers, strength toward rejecters, freedom from fear of blame, and reception of divine bounty. These relations specify the human texture of the exertion.

activation_trace.role: Costly exertion anchors the focus command that the later profile embodies.
The God-owned traversable road anchors the phrase repeated in the profile.
Love abiding in the heart makes exertion responsive to mutual attachment rather than self-generated aggression.
Gentleness without abasement supplies the inward-facing manner of the striving community.
Strength after lowliness supplies firmness without canceling the paired gentleness.
The repeated exertion root directly carries the focus command into this relational profile.
The repeated road root confirms that the profile inhabits the same God-owned course.
Expected harm from social censure is present but no longer governs the path.
Blame for alleged fault supplies the social pressure from which directed exertion remains independent.
Gift and beneficence frame the entire capacity to strive as received bounty rather than earned superiority.

structural_cues: 5:54 repeats يُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ nearly verbatim and embeds it between mutual love, paired gentleness/strength, fearlessness before blame, and divine bounty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one syntactic profile around the repeated phrase; I infer that its neighboring qualities specify the mode of jihad. A live alternative treats them as cumulative virtues of the same people without making each a strict condition of the term.

changed_reading.before: Jihad is an abstract or primarily adversarial expenditure of force.
changed_reading.after: Jihad is love-originated relational stamina: gentle without abasement, firm without ego, unruled by blame, and understood as gifted capacity while traveling God's way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement defines near, supportive allegiance through God, the messenger, and believing practitioners of prayer, giving, and bowing, then names a gathered party whose outcome is prevailing. The Godward means can therefore be carried communally as enacted loyalty, not possessed privately as an access device.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped endpoint anchors the focus's 'toward Him' and 'His way' in a relation rather than an object.
Love, support, and allegiance supply the social bond through which Godward orientation is practiced.
Specified worship gives allegiance a repeated embodied practice.
Growth and increase make giving a circulation that builds communal life rather than private depletion.
Bowing as humility prevents communal allegiance from becoming self-exalting solidarity.
Nearness without an intervening gap turns allegiance into a relational mode of approach.
A group gathered around a position makes the route corporate rather than merely individual.
Prevailing strength supplies a communal counterpart to the focus's hoped-for falah.

structural_cues: 5:55-56 repeat allegiance and belief, move through prayer, giving, and bowing, and close the packet with a gathered God-aligned party that prevails.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relational nearness, concrete communal practices, and collective prevailing; I infer that these can embody the focus's means of approach. A live alternative reads the closing verses only as defining valid allegiance, not as unpacking wasila.

changed_reading.before: The means is an individual technique for securing private proximity and success.
changed_reading.after: The means can be a lived network of Godward allegiance: worship, redistributive growth, humility, and mutual support carry approach communally, with falah reframed as shared prevailing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps textual placement onto travel rather than claiming a direct lexical gloss of sabil. It remains anchored in the focus's road and the context's explicit movement of words away from assigned places. Downstream prose should mark it as a hermeneutic-spatial analogy, not identify every interpretive disagreement as path-corruption.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِي سَبِيلِهِ as a course that can be kept or left.

activation_trace.role: A traversable extended road supplies the focus anchor for faithful orientation.
Deflection away from a direction gives distortion the shape of leaving a course.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the material whose orientation is manipulated.
A thing's assigned settled place supplies the position from which speech is displaced.

changed_reading.before: The Godward means concerns conduct on an external road, while handling words is a separate issue.
changed_reading.after: Keeping meaningful words oriented in their assigned places may itself be pathkeeping; displaced speech can engineer a counterfeit means by bending the verbal road.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines hard land, rain, grain, a water-source, an opened outlet, and plowing into one material analogy. It remains focus-anchored through jihad, sabil, and falah and context-anchored through explicit branch inventories. Downstream prose must present it as an exploratory ecological model, never as the translation or exclusive referent of wasila.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ, with the uncited surface وَسِيلَة naming the enabling relation.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed land supplies the resistant field in which exertion occurs.
Rain suspended between cloud and earth supplies a descending life-channel.
The extended grain-ear supplies the route's cultivated yield.
The farmer who splits earth turns falah into sustained cultivation rather than instant reward.
Earth revived by rain connects life-preservation to the material yield of a watered route.
A manifest water-access point gives the means the shape of reaching a sustaining source.
Water bursting from its outlet supplies the enabling release that irrigates the hard field.

changed_reading.before: The path is a road already laid out, and flourishing is a prize at its end.
changed_reading.after: The path can be imagined as an irrigation and cultivation system: access reaches a source, an opening releases life, hard ground is worked, and flourishing grows as grain rather than arriving as a detached prize.

strongest_changes: The means became an accepted and enacted approach conditioned by taqwa, not a self-validating offering, stored asset, or late ransom.
Jihad became directionally and relationally bounded: life-ordering course, heart-rooted love, gentleness and firmness, and durable work matter more than force or oath-intensity.
The singular Godward way became compatible with traced succession and differentiated tested routes whose shared measure is racing in useful good and returning to God.
Repeated ب غ ي showed that desire is morally formed by its object, while the opening imagery made falah a release from fearful circulation rather than favorable positioning within it.
summary.what_was_special: Exact root recurrences across the packet did most of the activating work: belief moved from mouth to heart, seeking split by its object, exertion failed as oath-intensity and returned inside a love-shaped profile, and path language expanded through traces, water-access, clear roads, opening, and communal allegiance.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet provides no branch inventory for the focus root و س ل, so models anchor the surface construction but cannot branch-cite الوسيلة itself.
The punitive material in 5:33 limits how far the life-preserving direction model can be rendered as a general nonviolence claim.
The differentiated routes in 5:48 may concern legal dispensations specifically rather than every dimension of the singular path in 5:35.
The opening, displaced-word, and irrigated-cultivation models are cross-root analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
